productionInstruction.objective: Create the requested GEN-042 phone-readable handoff from the authorized project inputs.
productionInstruction.scope: One Markdown service handoff for GEN-042.
procedure: Record unit identifier and service date.
Record completed service actions and start/stop check result.
Record exterior leak inspection without inventing evidence.
Apply the safety gate: if a safety-critical condition is found or cannot be established, use UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and prohibit ready-for-service.
Include the complete escalation path from SITE_POLICY.md.
Produce the Markdown handoff only after all required fields are resolved under the stated rules.
productionInstruction.failureBehavior: Missing mandatory safety evidence produces UNKNOWN and BLOCKED, not a positive readiness statement.
productionInstruction.completionCriteria: All five mandatory requirements have affirmative evidence and assigned validators are ready.
